ads.sub: A warm bath 1 to 2 hours before bed helped people fall asleep sooner.
ads.src: Review of 17 studies on warm baths · PubMed 31102877
ads.primary: In a review of 17 studies, a warm bath 1 to 2 hours before bed helped people fall asleep sooner. As little as 10 minutes was enough. We made those minutes something you look forward to: a magnesium bath soak with a scent made for the night.
ads.headline: Why the hour before bed matters
ads.description: The research is linked on the page
